generate_mesh_from_image: generate a 3D mesh from an input image using VFusion3D and export as OBJ file
generate_video_from_image: generate an orbiting video of a 3D model reconstructed from a single input image
preprocess_input_image: preprocess an input image by removing background, recentering, and normalizing for 3D generation
build_camera_intrinsics: build normalized camera intrinsics and principle matrices from RT extrinsics and focal parameters
launch_gradio_demo: launch a Gradio demo app for uploading images and generating 3D meshes or orbiting videos
